atomic_gap: Bind legal fallthrough after a conclusively failed earlier SEARCH/JUMP candidate to production artifacts without converting missing evidence or arbitrary audit failures into rejection authority.

successor_contract.issuance_rule: Certificates are minted only inside the resolver after the existing canonical audit returns FAIL for the exact candidate review and every audit reason is in the registered conclusive-rejection allowlist.
successor_contract.residual_view_rule: A certified rejected episode is removed only from an ephemeral residual routing-memory view. Canonical transformation memory is not mutated, superseded, or rewritten. The certificate binds the input snapshot and the derived output snapshot.
successor_contract.uncertainty_rule: CANNOT_CHECK never mints a rejection certificate and always blocks fallthrough.
successor_contract.priority_rule: SEARCH remains higher priority than JUMP; JUMP remains higher than GLUE; GLUE remains higher than LIFT. A later route is considered only after every earlier structural candidate has either passed (and wins), been conclusively certified rejected, or been absent.
successor_contract.glue_boundary: This version does not certify rejected GLUE compositions; inconclusive/failed GLUE remains fail-closed. The successor may still reach GLUE or LIFT after typed SEARCH/JUMP rejections when the residual view and existing canonical audit permit it.
successor_contract.authority: routing/proposal only; no theorem, novelty, scientific, or model-efficacy authority
